errorCodes.meaning: No policy module with that id.
The module failed to evaluate — a compile error, or the queried rule does not exist.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

purpose.description: Governance purpose the module is classified under.

result.description: Raw result of the queried rule, uninterpreted. May be any JSON value, including absent-as-null.

sha256.description: Digest of the evaluated module, so a caller can confirm which bytes ran.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

purpose.description: Governance purpose the module is classified under.

result.description: Raw result of the queried rule, uninterpreted. May be any JSON value, including absent-as-null.

sha256.description: Digest of the evaluated module, so a caller can confirm which bytes ran.

id.description: Identifier of the stored policy module to evaluate.

input.description: Facts to evaluate against. Deliberately schema-free: community policies decide over community-shaped input.

query.description: Rule to evaluate. Any rule in the module, not only an allow decision.
